name: com.unity.2d.spriteshape
description: SpriteShape Runtime & Editor Package contains the tooling and the runtime component that allows you to create very organic looking spline based 2D worlds. It comes with intuitive configurator and a highly performant renderer.

samples.description: Samples to get started with SpriteShape
This sample has utility scripts that has various use-cases of SpriteShape

_upm.changelog:
### Added
- Added `PhysicsAreaSpriteShape`, a 2D Physics Core component that builds polygons or chain segments from a SpriteShapeController's spline and rebuilds them when the controller reports a change. Available when the `com.unity.2d.physics` package is installed.
